Name: Duruznik's Portraits for Stardew Valley Expanded
Author: Duruznik
Description:
Trying out a fresh new look for your game, but want your SVE NPCs to match? Try these on for size! This mod matches my vanilla portraits and covers all SVE characters. Covers all outfits, events, the works!

[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/52394/52394-1789570029-688251244.png[/img]

1. You will need to have [url=https://smapi.io/][b]SMAPI[/b] [/url]and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915][b]Content Patcher[/b] [/url]installed. 
2. This is a hi-res mod, which means you'll need to have [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/36813][b]Scale Up Unofficial[/b][/url] installed.
3. Simply download the file and drop it into your mods folder. 

[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/52394/52394-1789570168-879809452.png[/img]

Supports older Sophia! Once you've started up your game at least once with this mod installed, it'll generate a config file in the mod folder. There, you can set the OlderSophia option to "True" if you want to enable it.

[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/52394/52394-1789570258-1447226643.png[/img]

Find my other portrait mods here!

[b]                        [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/46344]Duruznik's Vanilla Portraits[/url][/b]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/46344][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/52562/52562-1789797642-1418497359.png[/img][/url]

More mod support coming soon!

[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/52394/52394-1789609371-551493326.png[/img]

For best experience, use alongside my vanilla portraits. Specifically, version 2.0 and up. The older versions might cause some weird conflicts.

Incompatible with other portraits that edit SVE characters using Scale Up. 

My portraits should work with any other mod that uses Portraiture, just be aware my portraits will appear under the 'vanilla' portrait set. 

IMPORTANT: If you're using a Portraiture mod that replaces portraits for Morris, Marlon, Gunther or the Wizard, be sure to press 'P' until you hit the vanilla portrait set when you first talk to them. Press 'O' to fix that selection in place for these NPCs. Otherwise, you may experience strange bugs when talking to them.

[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/52562/52562-1789758777-1548795477.png[/img]

Huge shoutout to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/DacarTheGorilla]Dacar [/url]for all his help, and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/DolphinIsNotaFish]DolphinIsNotaFish[/url] for being a godsend in helping me set up the code. Also a massive shoutout to the good folks in the Stardew Valley Discord server's modding community!
